notes: Per-NR-iteration score vector + Hessian assembly for the OrdinalGLMM cumulative-link threshold update. Inner work is O(n * n_thresh^2). OpenMP across samples with per-thread accumulators reduced at end. Random gamma_nr inputs from a logistic-link template; Y uniform over {0..J-1}.
scaling: Speedup scales with n_thresh^2 because the Python overhead is per (jj, kk) pair while the C++ inner loop is straight-line. Exceeds the audit's 3-15x estimate at J >= 5.
